units.source_text: ……作为实际问题，直到参加大谷大学考试以前的这段时间，我降了一味揣摩老师的意向以外，真是束手无策。

en.t: As a practical matter, during the whole period before I sat for the Otani University entrance examination, I could do nothing but keep trying to guess the teacher's intentions.

units.source_text: 老师一次也不曾推翻过让我升学的口头保证，但是，他也不曾催促过我做好考试的准备。

en.t: The teacher never once went back on his verbal assurance that he would let me continue my studies, but neither did he urge me to prepare for the examination.

units.source_text: 不论哪层意思，我多么盼望老师的一句话啊。

en.t: Whatever his meaning might have been, how I longed for a single word from him.

units.source_text: 可是老师却故意刁难，保持沉默，仿佛让我接受长时间的拷问。

en.t: But the teacher seemed deliberately harsh and kept silent, as though he were making me endure a prolonged interrogation.

units.source_text: 我也不知道是由于害怕，还是出于反抗，总之再也无法就升学问题探询老师的意向。

en.t: I did not know whether it was out of fear or out of defiance, but in any case I could no longer ask the teacher about his intentions regarding my further studies.

units.source_text: 过去我和普通人一样，对老师怀有敬意，如今却用批判的目光凝视着他，他的身影渐渐变成一只庞大的怪物，再也看不见有人性的存在。

en.t: In the past, like ordinary people, I had felt respect for the teacher, but now I stared at him with a critical eye; his figure gradually turned into a vast monster, and I could no longer see any trace of humanity in him.

units.source_text: 我好几次试图把脸扭过去不瞧它，可它依然存在，活像一座奇怪的城堡盘踞在那里。

en.t: Several times I tried to turn my face away and not look at it, but it still existed there, crouching like a strange castle.
